record.paper_title: Negative (and Positive) Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: Generalize the spectral existence results for odd and even cycles to signed graphs: determine for which signed simple graphs Nikiforov-type eigenvalue conditions force the existence of negative or positive circles, and determine whether the Yuan and Nikiforov–Yuan upper-bound theorems for forbidden odd or even cycle lengths extend to signed simple graphs with negative or positive circles of prescribed lengths.

evidence.quote: Qn. 1. Does Nikiforov’s theorem, with bipartiteness changed to balance, apply to all signed simple graphs that meet the conditions of the theorem of [N]. If not, to which ones does it apply?

Qn. 2. Do Yuan’s theorem and that of Nikiforov and Yuan generalize to signed simple graphs that meet conditions similar to those of their theorems, with C2k+1 replaced by a negative Cl and C2k changed to a positive Cl?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A signed simple graph is a pair $(G,\sigma)$ where $G=(V,E)$ is a simple graph and $\sigma:E\to\{+1,-1\}$ is an edge signing. The sign of a circle (cycle) $C$ in $(G,\sigma)$ is $\sigma(C)=\prod_{e\in E(C)}\sigma(e)$; $C$ is called positive if $\sigma(C)=+1$ and negative if $\sigma(C)=-1$. The signed graph is balanced if every circle is positive. The adjacency matrix $A(G,\sigma)$ is the symmetric matrix with entries $A_{uv}=\sigma(uv)$ if $uv\in E$ and $0$ otherwise; its largest eigenvalue is denoted $\lambda_1(G,\sigma)$.

Recall the following classical (unsigned) spectral results:

(i) (Nikiforov) There exists an explicit spectral condition on the largest eigenvalue $\lambda_1(G)$ of a simple graph $G$, in terms of the number of vertices and edges of $G$, that forces $G$ to contain an odd cycle (equivalently, to be non-bipartite).

(ii) (Yuan; Nikiforov–Yuan) For each integer $\ell\ge 3$, if a simple graph $G$ on $n$ vertices contains no cycle $C_\ell$ of length $\ell$ (with separate theorems for odd $\ell=2k+1$ and even $\ell=2k$), then $\lambda_1(G)$ satisfies an explicit upper bound depending on $n$ and $\ell$.

The problem is to determine the following:

(a) For which signed simple graphs $(G,\sigma)$ does the analogue of Nikiforov's theorem hold with "bipartite" replaced by "balanced" and "odd cycle" replaced by "negative circle"? That is, characterize the class of signed simple graphs for which the same spectral hypothesis on $\lambda_1(G,\sigma)$ implies the existence of a negative circle, and decide whether this analogue holds for all signed simple graphs satisfying the hypothesis.

(b) Do the theorems of Yuan and of Nikiforov–Yuan generalize to signed simple graphs in the following form: with $C_{2k+1}$ replaced by a negative circle $C_\ell^-$ of length $\ell$, and with $C_{2k}$ replaced by a positive circle $C_\ell^+$ of length $\ell$, do the analogous spectral upper bounds on $\lambda_1(G,\sigma)$ hold under the corresponding forbidden-circle hypotheses?
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent works develop signed spectral Turán-type theorems and prove spectral upper bounds for signed graphs forbidding certain negative or positive circles (e.g., $C_4^-$-free and $C_k^-$-free signed graphs by Wang, Hou, Li and others, 2022–2025), giving partial generalizations of the Nikiforov and Nikiforov–Yuan theorems to the signed setting. A complete characterization for all signed simple graphs and all circle lengths does not appear to be settled.

status_evidence.title: Signed spectral Turán type theorems
status_evidence.snippet: Spectral Turán-type results for signed graphs forbidding negative/positive circles, extending Nikiforov-type bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Partial generalizations of Nikiforov-type spectral conditions to signed graphs have been obtained.

status_evidence.title: The largest eigenvalue of C_k^- -free signed graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes spectral upper bounds for signed graphs containing no negative cycle of given length.
status_evidence.claim: Yuan/Nikiforov–Yuan style bounds have been extended to certain forbidden negative circles in signed graphs.

status_evidence.title: The largest eigenvalue of C_4^- -free signed graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Spectral extremal result for signed graphs without a negative 4-cycle.
status_evidence.claim: Specific cases of the proposed signed generalization are proved, but the full problem remains.
